agentsSpawnedInPhase0_2.evidence: Skill spec line 107: 'All agents are spawned on-demand when their phase begins — not upfront.' Phase 0.2 only defines the protocol template.

graduatedElicitation.evidence: Skill spec lines 138-139: 'High confidence (80-94%): Ask 1-3 targeted questions about specific remaining gaps. Do not over-elicit when the user has been thorough.'

designDecisionsDeferredToArchitects.evidence: Skill spec line 141: 'For implementation details that architects can resolve in Phase 4, note them as deferred to architecture rather than asking the user. Only ask users about requirements gaps, not design gaps.'
